description: Source code for a video screencast encoder using libvpx, integrated with Mozilla's threading and WebM writing infrastructure. Implements frame conversion, encoding, and file writing for screencast data.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder::VPXFrame
classes.description: Represents a video frame to be encoded, with conversion to vpx_image_t.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder::VPXCodec
classes.description: Handles encoding of frames using libvpx, manages threading and file output.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder
classes.description: Main encoder class that manages frame queuing, encoding, and finalization.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates and initializes a vpx_image_t with specified width and height, allocates buffer.

methods.name: encodeFrameAsync
methods.description: Encodes a frame asynchronously on a dedicated thread.

methods.name: finishAsync
methods.description: Finalizes encoding asynchronously and calls a callback.

methods.name: flushLastFrame
methods.description: Sets duration for the last frame and queues it for encoding.

methods.name: encodeFrame
methods.description: Queues a video frame for encoding.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes encoding and writes out remaining data.
